property_summary: For any uint256 delta passed to AdjustBetAmounts when the initial betLimit is nonzero, the reference contract sets betLimit equal to that delta (overwriting previous value) only when initial betLimit was zero, but more generally the invariant is that performing AdjustBetAmounts with amount = 0 is a no-op on the reference (leaves betLimit unchanged) while the mutant increments betLimit by 0 (also no-op) — that was tried; instead we use two sequential calls: in the reference, calling AdjustBetAmounts(a) then AdjustBetAmounts(b) results in betLimit == b (second call overwrites) whereas the mutant results in betLimit == a + b (accumulates), so the rule is: after two consecutive AdjustBetAmounts calls, the reference's betLimit equals the second call's parameter; the mutant violates this for some fuzzed (a,b).
change_summary: Replace assignment to betLimit with assignment that adds amount to existing betLimit (cumulative update) so AdjustBetAmounts increases instead of setting it.
